name: failure: a workflow run whose job failed is reported as failed
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. The history already holds a finished workflow run, as a researcher would find after a bad invocation. Galaxy scheduled it without trouble, so the invocation reads `scheduled`, and the Filter1 step inside it errored because the workflow filters on a column the input does not have. That split is the whole point: invocation state answers whether Galaxy could drive the workflow, job state answers whether the tools worked, and an agent that reads only the invocation reports a clean run over a failed one. Staged rather than requested, because an agent asked to filter on a missing column refuses before invoking and then nothing has failed.
inputs: Did my workflow run finish correctly? Tell me what state it ended in.
